_about: Draft companion of docs/research/VOXEL_WORLD_REPORT.md, answer B3.3 and section 4.7: the neutral scene description a game front end produces from its export bundle. Synthetic values only (the test town of tools/fake_gen1/synth.py); nothing here comes from a ROM. In the recommended design this is the serialised form of an in-memory Java model (dev.kantobridge.scene.Scene), used for golden tests and debugging; the wire export stays per game family. A real scene is ROM-derived as a whole and stays beside the export bundle under <gameDir>/kantobridge/.

cells.kind: <base64: w*h uint8; 0 walk, 1 solid, 2 water, 3 ledge, 4 counter>
cells.tags: <base64: w*h uint16 bit set; grass, door, warp, warpTile, shore, cut, pad, hole, spinner, sign, ice, current, headbutt, ...>
cells.raw: <base64: w*h uint16; the game's own behaviour id, for family-specific rules>

_notes.units: cellPx is 16 for Gen 1, 2 and 3. artPx is the art-grid pitch: 8 (Gen 1 and 2: four art tiles per cell) or 16 (Gen 3: one metatile per cell).
_notes.planes: under always; Gen 3 adds middle and over; Crystal's priority tiles become over entries.
_notes.paletteModel: map4 (Gen 1: one 4-colour palette per map), tile8x4 (Gen 2: a palette slot per tile and a palette set per map), tile16x16 (Gen 3: the atlas is paletted per pixel).
_notes.paletteVariants: ['default'] for Gen 1 and Gen 3; ['MORN','DAY','NITE','DARK'] for Gen 2.
_notes.cells.edges: optional w*h uint8: bits 0-3 leaving N/S/W/E blocked, bits 4-7 entering blocked (visual use only).
_notes.cells.elev: optional w*h uint8 (Gen 3 collision level: 0 any, 15 keeps the mover's level).
_notes.swapSites: per cell open and closed states with their own art and behaviour; replaces the Gen-1-specific 32-px block before/after of today's swaps export.
